Claude validated this and asked a follow-up about the specific issue Jade was encountering, but the conversation ended there.

Jade communicates directly and informally, uses expressive language when frustrated, and is clearly familiar with nonprofit legal structures and payment processing infrastructure. TMI's core legal identity as a 508(c)(1)(a) organization and its EIN (42-2419586) are key reference points for ongoing administrative and financial setup work.
